notes.title: Demo Out Now !
notes.content:
Exciting news! The free demo of Bunny Hop Hop is now available on Steam!

What's in the Demo:


 Play through a selection of vibrant, hand-crafted levels.
 Meet some of the adorable yet mischievous enemies.
 Get a taste of the  game mechanics and the hand-drawn art style.


What's Coming in the Full Game:


 Even more captivating levels to explore and conquer.
 Additional quirky enemies and fun obstacles.
 More weapons!
 Enhanced gameplay features based on your valuable feedback.


Play the demo, add Bunny Hop Hop to your wishlist, and share your thoughts—we'd love your feedback to make the game even better.

Happy hopping!

notes.title: Bunny Hop Hop is Now on Steam!
notes.content:
We're excited to share that Bunny Hop Hop’s Steam page is officially live! 🐰✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335782/83279aa8635ff5f36dc019caccb22c82b49a0751.png

The game is still in development, and we’re working hard to bring this cozy, retro-inspired adventure to life. Can you guess which classic game inspired some of Bunny Hop Hop's mechanics?

Demo coming soon...
Over the coming months, we’ll be sharing updates on new game mechanics, quirky enemies, and exciting features. We’re also working on a demo, which will give you a chance to try the game and share your thoughts as we continue to refine it.

Please consider FOLLOWING and WISHLISTING the Steam page, as we will be sharing more updates very soon!
